description: This file defines the RuleEngineAlarmService interface, which provides methods for managing alarms within the Thingsboard rule engine, including creating, updating, acknowledging, clearing, assigning, unassigning, and querying alarms.

classes.name: RuleEngineAlarmService
classes.description: Interface defining alarm management operations within the rule engine, including creation, update, acknowledgment, clearing, assignment, unassignment, and querying of alarms.

methods.name: createAlarm
methods.description: Creates a new alarm, designed for atomic operations over active alarms, ensuring only one active alarm per originator and type.

methods.name: updateAlarm
methods.description: Updates an existing alarm with partial fields.

methods.name: acknowledgeAlarm
methods.description: Acknowledges an alarm, marking it as acknowledged at a specific timestamp.

methods.name: clearAlarm
methods.description: Clears an alarm, optionally with details and push event.

methods.name: assignAlarm
methods.description: Assigns an alarm to a user with a timestamp.

methods.name: unassignAlarm
methods.description: Unassigns an alarm from a user.

methods.name: deleteAlarm
methods.description: Deletes an alarm by ID.

methods.name: findAlarmByIdAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds an alarm by ID.

methods.name: findAlarmById
methods.description: Finds an alarm by ID synchronously.

methods.name: findLatestActiveByOriginatorAndType
methods.description: Finds the latest active alarm for a given originator and type.

methods.name: findLatestActiveByOriginatorAndTypeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds the latest active alarm for a given originator and type.

methods.name: findLatestByOriginatorAndType
methods.description: Finds the latest alarm for a given originator and type.

methods.name: findAlarmInfoById
methods.description: Retrieves alarm info by ID.

methods.name: findAlarmInfoByIdAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves alarm info by ID.

methods.name: findAlarms
methods.description: Finds alarms based on a query.

methods.name: findCustomerAlarms
methods.description: Finds alarms for a specific customer based on a query.

methods.name: findAlarmsV2
methods.description: Finds alarms using the version 2 query.

methods.name: findCustomerAlarmsV2
methods.description: Finds customer alarms using the version 2 query.

methods.name: findHighestAlarmSeverity
methods.description: Finds the highest severity of alarms for an entity with specific statuses and assignee.

methods.name: findAlarmDataByQueryForEntities
methods.description: Finds alarm data for a collection of entities based on a query.

methods.name: findAlarmTypesByTenantId
methods.description: Finds alarm types for a tenant with pagination.
